snippet.title: Free Ball - Early Build Trailer
snippet.description:
Free Ball is a volleyball game that blends arcade-style abilities with competitive esports gameplay. Master the fundamentals of volleyball while unleashing powerful abilities that can turn the tide of a rally in an instant.

Learn more: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/freeball/free-ball-3rd-person-volleyball-game-with-special-abilities
